bullets.id: Emas menutup pekan di sekitar .884, turun 5% dalam sepekan menurut Kitco, dengan rentang mingguan dari .148,95 pada Senin hingga .852,10 pada Kamis, terendah tahun ini. Survei mingguan Kitco berbalik tajam: 10 dari 13 analis Wall Street (62%) bearish, hanya 2 bullish, dan porsi bullish investor ritel turun ke 42% dari 160 suara.
bullets.en: Gold ended the week near ,884, down 5% on the week according to Kitco, with a weekly range from ,148.95 on Monday to ,852.10 on Thursday, the year’s low. Kitco’s weekly survey turned sharply: 10 of 13 Wall Street analysts (62%) are bearish and only 2 bullish, while the bullish share of retail investors fell to 42% of 160 votes.

bullets.id: Tekanan datang dari yield dan dolar. Yield Treasury 10 tahun berada di 5,15% dan indeks dolar di 103,41, dekat tertinggi 19 bulan. CME FedWatch memberi peluang sekitar 90% untuk kenaikan 25 bps pada 9 Desember dan sekitar 10% untuk 50 bps. Emas juga sekitar 6,5% di bawah rata-rata 50 hari di .154.
bullets.en: The pressure comes from yields and the dollar. The 10-year Treasury yield is at 5.15% and the dollar index at 103.41, near a 19-month high. CME FedWatch puts the odds of a 25 bp hike on 9 December at about 90% and of 50 bp at about 10%. Gold is also about 6.5% below its 50-day average at ,154.

bullets.id: Support terdekat ada di .852, lalu .800 dan .790; RoboForex memperkirakan rentang pekan ini .790–.900. Resistance berada di .900, lalu .000. Agenda pekan ini: komentar Ketua Fed Kevin Warsh pada Senin, penjualan ritel Oktober pada Selasa, risalah rapat Fed pada Rabu 18 November, dan klaim pengangguran pada Kamis.
bullets.en: The nearest support is ,852, then ,800 and ,790; RoboForex expects a ,790–,900 range this week. Resistance sits at ,900, then ,000. This week’s agenda: comments from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh on Monday, October retail sales on Tuesday, the Fed minutes on Wednesday, 18 November, and jobless claims on Thursday.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram stagnan di Rp2.517.000 dengan buyback Rp2.293.000, sehingga spread tetap Rp224.000 (sekitar 8,9%). Galeri24 turun Rp6.000 ke Rp2.456.000 (buyback Rp2.312.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS turun Rp5.000 ke Rp2.480.000 (buyback Rp2.286.000, spread sekitar 7,8%).
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price held at Rp2,517,000 with buyback at Rp2,293,000, keeping the spread at Rp224,000 (about 8.9%). Galeri24 fell Rp6,000 to Rp2,456,000 (buyback Rp2,312,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS fell Rp5,000 to Rp2,480,000 (buyback Rp2,286,000, spread about 7.8%).
